# sophosfirewall_nat_rule (Data Source)

Looks up an existing NAT rule by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sophosfirewall_nat_rule" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the NAT rule.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `health_check` (Attributes) Health check for load-balanced destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `inbound_interfaces` (Set of String) Inbound interfaces to match. Omit to match any interface.
- `linked_firewall_rule` (String) Name of the firewall rule this NAT rule is linked to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `load_balancing_method` (String) Load balancing method when the translated destination resolves to several hosts. One of `roundRobin`, `firstAlive`, `random`, `stickyIp`, `oneToOne`.
- `original_destination_networks` (Attributes) Original destination addresses to match. Omit to match any network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--original_destination_networks))
- `original_service_groups` (Set of String) Original service groups to match.
- `original_services` (Set of String) Original services to match. Omit both `original_services` and `original_service_groups` to match any service.
- `original_source_networks` (Attributes) Original source addresses to match. Omit to match any network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--original_source_networks))
- `outbound_interfaces` (Set of String) Outbound interfaces to match. Omit to match any interface.
- `position` (String) Where to place the NAT rule. One of `top`, `bottom`, `before`, `after`. New rules default to `bottom`. The firewall does not report rule positions, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `position_reference` (String) Name of the NAT rule to place this one `before` or `after`. Required for those positions.
- `source_nat_overrides` (Attributes List) Per outbound interface overrides of `translated_source`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_nat_overrides))
- `translated_destination` (Attributes) Destination NAT (DNAT). Omit to keep the original destination. Set exactly one of `ipv4_address` or `fqdn_address`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--translated_destination))
- `translated_service` (String) Name of the service to translate to (port forwarding). Omit to keep the original service.
- `translated_source` (Attributes) Source NAT (SNAT). Omit to keep the original source. Set exactly one of `masquerade` or `ipv4_address`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--translated_source))

<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Read-Only:

- `interval` (Number) Probe interval in seconds (5-65535).
- `port` (Number) TCP port to probe.
- `protocol` (String) Probe protocol. One of `tcp`, `icmp`.
- `retries` (Number) Probe retries (1-10).
- `timeout` (Number) Probe timeout in seconds (1-10).
